summary: Measure a defined workload reproducibly while separating compilation, warmup, queueing and device execution.
outcomes: Design fair kernel and end-to-end comparisons.

sequence: Define exactly which latency or throughput matters.
Expose asynchronous timing errors with a host timer.

Control input shape, cache state, clocks and competing work where practical.
Report variability and test a performance hypothesis.
